description: V-CCT is a website-based virtual-client conversation tool developed by Oster and colleagues for health-profession students to practise motivational-interviewing responses through simulated text dialogues.
title: V-CCT (Virtual Client Conversation Tool)

description: V-SeMo is an open-source web application developed by Sven Weissenborn and colleagues that lets learners explore and manipulate virtual sector models of spacetime through interactive tools and guided activities.
title: V-SeMo interactive web application for virtual sector models
